beliefs: f(x) = 0 exactly for x <= -4 and for x >= 4 [E1, E3]
On (-4, 4) f is a decreasing straight line f(x) = 5.2 - 2.5x [E1, E2]
The line crosses zero at x = 2.08, so f is positive on (-4, 2.08) and negative on (2.08, 4) [E2]
For x >= 2.1 the line's negative values are clamped to 0, giving -0.0 [E4]
Between 2.08 and 2.1 the line's negative values are reported unclamped (e.g. -0.05 at x=2.1, -0.0497 at 2.0999) [E4]
The clamp onset is at exactly x = 2.1 (values up to 2.0999 unclamped, 2.1 and above clamped) [E4]
The earlier apparent onset near 2.095 was a misreading; E4 shows unclamped values through 2.0999 [E4]
notes: Moved the clamp threshold from ~2.095 to exactly 2.1, since E4 shows unclamped values up to 2.0999 and clamped at 2.1; also removed the special-case that let x=2.09 stay unclamped (it's naturally below 2.1 now).
